name: npc:break
summary: Breaks out of the innermost loop containing the current instruction by jumping the instruction pointer to the instruction that marks the loop's end.

name: npc:call
summary: Compiler-generated function call: pushes an entry {key, index} onto the process call stack and jumps the instruction pointer to the function at the given index. The return is handled by npc:return.

args.name: key
args.desc: Variable key that npc:return will store the returned value in (empty/nil if the result is not wanted).

args.name: index
args.desc: Instruction index of the first instruction of the function being called.

name: npc:execute
summary: Executes another program.

args.name: name
args.desc: Name of the program to be executed. Must be the name of any program that is registered with `npc.proc.register_program`

args.name: args
args.desc: Arguments for the program

name: npc:exit
summary: Exits the current program: advances the instruction pointer past the last instruction of the program, so a new program will be picked up on the next entity step.

name: npc:get_proc_interval
summary: Returns the current process execution interval (in seconds).

name: npc:jump
summary: Sets the process's current instruction pointer. If offset is true, pos is added to the current instruction index; otherwise pos replaces it.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Instruction position to jump to (or the relative offset when offset is true).

args.name: offset
args.desc: If true, treat pos as a relative offset from the current instruction instead of an absolute position.

name: npc:jump_if
summary: Evaluates a condition expression and, if the result is true (or false when negate is set), jumps the instruction pointer to pos (optionally as a relative offset).

args.name: expr
args.desc: Condition to evaluate (expression/callable that yields a boolean).

args.name: negate
args.desc: If true, the condition is negated before the jump decision.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Instruction position to jump to (or relative offset when offset is true).

args.name: offset
args.desc: If true, treat pos as a relative offset from the current instruction.

name: npc:return
summary: Compiler-generated function return: pops the top entry of the call stack, stores the returned value in the variable named by the entry's key (if any), and restores the instruction pointer.

args.name: value
args.desc: Value returned by the function call; stored in the variable key recorded by npc:call.

name: npc:set_default_program
summary: Sets the given program as the NPC's default (state) process - the program that runs continuously - optionally with arguments.

args.name: name
args.desc: Name of the program to set as the default (state) process.

args.name: args
args.desc: Arguments passed to the default program.

name: npc:set_proc_interval
summary: Sets the process execution interval (in seconds) to the given value, controlling how often the process steps.

args.name: value
args.desc: New process interval in seconds.

name: npc:var:get
summary: Reads the value of the named process variable and returns it.

args.name: key
args.desc: Name of the variable to read (may use @storage prefixes and subkey syntax).

name: npc:var:set
summary: Sets the named process variable to the given value, with storage and userdata-type handling for non-serializable values.

args.name: key
args.desc: Name of the variable to set (may use @storage prefixes and subkey syntax).

args.name: value
args.desc: Value to store.

args.name: userdata_type
args.desc: How userdata values are stored (e.g. "object"); defaults to "object".

args.name: storage_type
args.desc: Storage to write to: "local", "global", "temp" or "args"; defaults from the key prefix or "local".

name: npc:wait
summary: Stop process execution for the desired time. This is not a busy wait, it instead changes the process interval in the right way.

args.name: time
args.desc: The time to wait, in seconds. Decimal values are supported, but it should be taken into account that it should never be smaller than `dtime` (the server's step time). This is not validated.

name: npc:move:get_pos
summary: Returns the NPC's own position, optionally rounded to integers.

args.name: round
args.desc: If true, the returned position is rounded using vector.round().

name: npc:move:jump
summary: Launches the NPC in a ballistic arc toward the target position (handling step-ups and drops) and arms a low-latency landing task that keeps the jump alive until it lands.

args.name: target_pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) to jump towards.

args.name: range
args.desc: Horizontal distance the NPC will move on the jump (default 1).

args.name: speed
args.desc: Base speed used to derive the jump arc (default 1).

args.name: middle
args.desc: If true, jump to the middle of the target block instead of the cell corner.

name: npc:move:rotate
summary: Turns the NPC (yaw only, no movement) so it faces the given target position.

args.name: target_pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) the NPC should face.

name: npc:move:stand
summary: Stops the NPC: zeroes its velocity and plays the "stand" animation once.

name: npc:move:to_pos
summary: Instantly moves the NPC to the given position (engine move_to, without collision handling).

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) to move the NPC to.

name: npc:move:walk
summary: Sets the NPC in motion towards a direction (by target position, yaw, or cardinal direction) at a given speed. It does not provide pathfinding and does not stop the NPC once in motion; use npc:move:stand to stop it.

args.name: speed
args.desc: Walk speed in m/s (default 2).

args.name: target_pos
args.desc: Position to rotate towards and walk towards (optional direction mode).

args.name: yaw
args.desc: Yaw to rotate to and walk in that direction (optional direction mode).

args.name: cardinal_dir
args.desc: Cardinal direction 0-7, representing north to north-west in a clockwise fashion (optional direction mode).

args.name: start_pos
args.desc: Position the NPC walks from (defaults to the NPC's current rounded position).

name: npc:move:walk_to_cell_ll
summary: Low-latency cell-arrival entry point for continuous following: walks to the goal cell (block-middle), and if the initial plan fails while following a leader, falls back to the slot ladder / direct steering instead of freezing.

args.name: target_pos
args.desc: Goal cell position (x/y/z) to walk to, typically the result of npc:nav:follow_goal.

args.name: target
args.desc: Target object to walk towards; its live position is used (alternative to target_pos).

args.name: speed
args.desc: Walk speed in m/s; when omitted it is derived from the leader's speed with catch-up hysteresis (or 5 m/s without a follow session).

args.name: target_distance
args.desc: Arrival distance in meters (default 1.5).

args.name: middle
args.desc: Walk/arrive at block-middle rather than cell-corner.

args.name: door_close
args.desc: "immediate" (default), "pause" or "none" - how a door is closed after the NPC passes through it.

args.name: check_end_pos_walkable
args.desc: If true, the end position is converted to a position the NPC can access/stand at.

args.name: look_at_target
args.desc: Whether to look at the target while walking.

args.name: original_target_pos
args.desc: Original target position before accessibility adjustment (used by the steering fallback).

args.name: force
args.desc: If no path can be found, move_to the target directly instead of failing.

args.name: min_self_move_distance
args.desc: Minimum self movement that counts as progress for stuck detection (default 0.25).

args.name: min_trgt_move_distance
args.desc: Minimum target movement that counts as progress for stuck detection (default 0.25).

name: npc:move:walk_to_pos
summary: Walks the NPC along a planned path to the target position (block-middle by default), handling stairs/slabs, jumps and doors via a per-tick low-latency task. Returns true when already arrived, false while moving, nil when the walk fails.

args.name: target_pos
args.desc: Target cell position (x/y/z) to walk to.

args.name: target
args.desc: Target object to walk towards; its live position is used (alternative to target_pos).

args.name: speed
args.desc: Walk speed in m/s (default 2); also drives how frequently the process re-arms while moving.

args.name: target_distance
args.desc: Arrival distance in meters (default 1.5).

args.name: middle
args.desc: Walk/arrive at block-middle rather than cell-corner (defaults to on for this instruction).

args.name: door_close
args.desc: "immediate" (default), "pause" or "none" - how a door is closed after the NPC passes through it.

args.name: check_end_pos_walkable
args.desc: If true, the end position is converted to a position the NPC can access/stand at.

args.name: look_at_target
args.desc: Whether to look at the target while walking.

args.name: original_target_pos
args.desc: Original target position before accessibility adjustment (used by the steering fallback).

args.name: force
args.desc: If no path can be found, move_to the target directly instead of failing.

args.name: min_self_move_distance
args.desc: Minimum self movement that counts as progress for stuck detection (default 0.25).

args.name: min_trgt_move_distance
args.desc: Minimum target movement that counts as progress for stuck detection (default 0.25).

name: npc:move:walk_to_pos_ll
summary: Low-latency entry point: walks the NPC to the target at a fixed speed of 3 m/s with distance-based arrival (1.5 m), driven by the per-tick low-latency walk task.

args.name: target_pos
args.desc: Target cell position (x/y/z) to walk to.

args.name: target
args.desc: Target object to walk towards; its live position is used (alternative to target_pos).

args.name: speed
args.desc: Walk speed in m/s; if omitted, the entry default of 3 m/s applies.

args.name: target_distance
args.desc: Arrival distance in meters (default 1.5).

args.name: middle
args.desc: Walk/arrive at block-middle rather than cell-corner.

args.name: door_close
args.desc: "immediate" (default), "pause" or "none" - how a door is closed after the NPC passes through it.

args.name: check_end_pos_walkable
args.desc: If true, the end position is converted to a position the NPC can access/stand at.

args.name: look_at_target
args.desc: Whether to look at the target while walking.

args.name: original_target_pos
args.desc: Original target position before accessibility adjustment (used by the steering fallback).

args.name: force
args.desc: If no path can be found, move_to the target directly instead of failing.

args.name: min_self_move_distance
args.desc: Minimum self movement that counts as progress for stuck detection (default 0.25).

args.name: min_trgt_move_distance
args.desc: Minimum target movement that counts as progress for stuck detection (default 0.25).

name: npc:nav:follow_goal
summary: Computes the follow goal cell for a leader (behind or ahead of the leader's predicted cell at a given distance/lead), updates the follow session (distance, speed, catch-up gap), and returns the goal cell for storing in a program variable.

args.name: name
args.desc: Name of the leader (player or entity) to follow.

args.name: object
args.desc: ObjectRef of the leader to follow (alternative to name).

args.name: mode
args.desc: Follow mode: "ahead" or behind (default when omitted).

args.name: distance
args.desc: Follow distance in cells (default 2).

args.name: lead
args.desc: Lead in cells applied to the goal cell (default 0 = the leader's current cell).

args.name: catch_up
args.desc: Catch-up gap in cells at which the follower resumes walking and switches to the catch-up speed (default 2x the follow distance).

args.name: speed
args.desc: Walk speed in m/s; overrides the speed derived from the leader's walk speed.

name: npc:env:chat:send_player
summary: Sends a chat message to a specific player.

args.name: player
args.desc: Name of the player to send the message to.

args.name: message
args.desc: Chat message to send.

name: npc:env:find_path
summary: Finds a path from a start position to an end position and stores it in the process-local `current_path` variable (nil when no path exists).

args.name: end_pos
args.desc: End position (x/y/z) of the path.

args.name: start_pos
args.desc: Start position of the path (defaults to the NPC's current rounded position).

args.name: decorate
args.desc: If true, the returned path is decorated with per-step node type information.

name: npc:env:node:can_stand_in
summary: Checks whether the NPC can stand at the given position: the node below is walkable, there is vertical clearance for the NPC to fit, and there is a walkable node to stand in.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the cell the NPC would stand in.

args.name: horizontal_radius
args.desc: Optional horizontal clearance radius to check around the NPC (not yet implemented).

name: npc:env:node:dig
summary: Digs (breaks) the node at the given position, playing the mining animation once.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node to dig.

name: npc:env:node:find
summary: Finds nodes matching given names or categories within a radius or area, optionally filtered by ownership/usage, and returns an array of positions (nil if none found).

args.name: pos
args.desc: Center of the search (defaults to the NPC's rounded position).

args.name: radius
args.desc: Search radius (defaults to the env view range); required if min_pos and max_pos are not given.

args.name: min_pos
args.desc: One corner of the search area (required together with max_pos).

args.name: max_pos
args.desc: Other corner of the search area (required together with min_pos).

args.name: nodenames
args.desc: Array of node names to find; required if categories is not given.

args.name: categories
args.desc: Array of node category names to find; required if nodenames is not given.

args.name: single_match
args.desc: Find only one node and return that node (optional, default true).

args.name: owned_only
args.desc: If true, only return nodes owned by the NPC (optional, default not checked).

args.name: used_only
args.desc: If true, only find used nodes; if false, only find un-used nodes (optional, default not checked).

args.name: y_radius
args.desc: Vertical radius used when deriving the search area from radius (defaults to radius).

args.name: y_offset
args.desc: Vertical offset applied to the derived search area center (default 0).

name: npc:env:node:get
summary: Returns the node (name, param1, param2) at the given position.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node to get.

name: npc:env:node:get_accessing_pos
summary: Returns a position from where the NPC can approach or access another position, e.g. the passable cell in front of a facedir node or a neighbouring passable cell (falling back to the given position when nothing suitable is found).

args.name: pos
args.desc: Target node position (x/y/z) to be accessed.

args.name: force
args.desc: If true, force searching for an accessing position even if the target node is walkable.

args.name: search_method
args.desc: Search method: "prefer_first" (default) or "prefer_closest".

name: npc:env:node:get_metadata
summary: Returns the node metadata object for the given position.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node whose metadata is read.

name: npc:env:node:get_property
summary: Reads a registered property of the node at the given position via the node's property handlers.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node.

args.name: property
args.desc: Name of the registered node property to read.

name: npc:env:node:is_owner
summary: Returns true if the node at the position is owned by this NPC, false if it is owned by someone else, and nil if it is unowned.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node to check.

name: npc:env:node:is_user
summary: Returns true if the node at the position is in use by this NPC, false if it is in use by someone else, and nil if it is unused.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node to check.

name: npc:env:node:operate
summary: Runs the operation registered for the node at the given position (node type dispatched to its handler); any additional arguments are passed through to that node's operation.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node to operate on; remaining operation-specific arguments are passed through to the node's registered operation.

name: npc:env:node:place
summary: Places a node at the given position (only where it is empty or buildable-to), honoring protection and the item source, playing the mining animation and the node's place sound.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) where the node is placed.

args.name: node
args.desc: Name of the node to place.

args.name: param1
args.desc: param1 of the placed node.

args.name: param2
args.desc: param2 of the placed node.

args.name: source
args.desc: Where the item comes from: "take" (from inventory), "take_or_forced" or "forced" (default).

args.name: bypass_protection
args.desc: Skip protection checks (default false).

args.name: play_sound
args.desc: Play the node's place sound (default true).

name: npc:env:node:set
summary: Sets the node at the given position directly via minetest.set_node, without checking protection or whether the node is buildable, playing the mining animation once.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node to set.

args.name: node
args.desc: Name of the node to set.

args.name: param1
args.desc: param1 of the set node.

args.name: param2
args.desc: param2 of the set node.

name: npc:env:node:set_metadata
summary: Sets the infotext metadata string of the node at the given position.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node.

args.name: meta
args.desc: Infotext string to set on the node metadata.

name: npc:env:node:set_owned
summary: Marks the node at the position as owned by this NPC (adding it to the node store), or releases ownership (removing it from the store and clearing the attribute). Returns true on success, false when the NPC cannot change ownership.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node.

args.name: value
args.desc: true to mark the node as owned, false to release ownership.

args.name: label
args.desc: Label to store with the node in the node store.

args.name: categories
args.desc: Array of store categories (default {"generic"}).

name: npc:env:node:set_used
summary: Marks the node at the position as in use by this NPC, or releases the mark when value is false. Returns true on success, false when the NPC cannot change the mark.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node.

args.name: value
args.desc: true to mark the node as in use, false to release the mark.

name: npc:env:node:store:add
summary: Adds a node to the NPC's node store under the given categories, keeping track of nodes the NPC cares about.

args.name: categories
args.desc: Array of category names to store the node under.

args.name: name
args.desc: Name of the node.

args.name: label
args.desc: Label for the node.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node.

args.name: is_primary
args.desc: Whether the node is a primary node of the category (default false).

name: npc:env:node:store:get
summary: Returns stored nodes from the NPC's node store matching the given filters, as a list (or a single entry when only_one is set).

args.name: categories
args.desc: Array of categories to search.

args.name: name
args.desc: Filter by node name (optional).

args.name: label
args.desc: Filter by label (optional).

args.name: pos
args.desc: Filter by position (optional).

args.name: is_primary
args.desc: Filter to only primary nodes (optional).

args.name: only_one
args.desc: If true, return the first matching node instead of a list.

name: npc:env:node:store:remove
summary: Removes stored nodes at the given position from the given categories of the NPC's node store; returns true if anything was removed.

args.name: categories
args.desc: Array of categories to remove from.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position (x/y/z) of the node to remove.

name: npc:env:prioritize
summary: Prioritizes an object in the NPC's environment object array based on the given criteria; the prioritized item is swapped to the front of the array.

args.name: distance
args.desc: Distance criteria: "min", "max", or an integer number.

args.name: entity_type
args.desc: Object type to prioritize: "player", "npc" or "monster".

name: npc:obj:get_dir
summary: Returns the direction vector (x/y/z) the given object is facing (derived from its yaw), optionally rounded.

args.name: object
args.desc: Object (ObjectRef) to query.

args.name: round
args.desc: If true, the returned vector is rounded using vector.round().

name: npc:obj:get_hp
summary: Returns the health (HP) of the given object.

args.name: object
args.desc: Object (ObjectRef) to query.

name: npc:obj:get_pos
summary: Returns the position of the given object, optionally rounded.

args.name: object
args.desc: Object (ObjectRef) to query.

args.name: round
args.desc: If true, the returned position is rounded using vector.round().

name: npc:obj:get_velocity
summary: Returns the velocity vector of the given object, optionally rounded.

args.name: object
args.desc: Object (ObjectRef) to query.

args.name: round
args.desc: If true, the returned vector is rounded using vector.round().

name: npc:obj:get_yaw
summary: Returns the yaw of the given object.

args.name: object
args.desc: Object (ObjectRef) to query.

name: npc:obj:punch
summary: Punches (attacks) a target object: faces it, plays the swing animation and fires the engine punch with the given damage group, enforcing a per-NPC punch cooldown. Returns "punched", "cooldown", "out_of_reach" or "no_target".

args.name: object
args.desc: ObjectRef of the target (e.g. from @objs.get[...])

args.name: name
args.desc: Target name, player or entity (alternative to object)

args.name: max_reach
args.desc: Punch reach in m (default 2)

args.name: interval
args.desc: Seconds between punches (default 0.7)

args.name: damage
args.desc: Damage dealt by a full-strength punch (default 1)

args.name: damage_group
args.desc: Target damage group the damage applies to (default "fleshy" - the group players belong to)

args.name: animation
args.desc: Swing animation (default "punch"; falls back to "mine_once" when the model has no "punch")

args.name: sound
args.desc: Sound name to play at the NPC (optional)

name: npc:inv:contains
summary: Returns whether the inventory can fully provide the given item (at least the given count, default 1), name-based and summed across slots.

args.name: item
args.desc: Item to check: an itemstring (e.g. "default:wood") or an ItemStack.

args.name: list
args.desc: Inventory list to check (default "main").

args.name: count
args.desc: Number of items required (default at least 1).

args.name: pos
args.desc: If given, operate on the node inventory at this position instead of the NPC's own.

args.name: player
args.desc: If given, operate on this player's inventory instead of the NPC's own.

name: npc:inv:get
summary: Returns the ItemStack in the given slot of the given list, or nil when the slot is empty.

args.name: index
args.desc: Slot index in the list.

args.name: list
args.desc: Inventory list to read from (default "main").

args.name: pos
args.desc: If given, operate on the node inventory at this position instead of the NPC's own.

args.name: player
args.desc: If given, operate on this player's inventory instead of the NPC's own.

name: npc:inv:hand
summary: Returns the NPC's held item (the "hand" slot), or nil when nothing is held.

name: npc:inv:list
summary: Returns the non-empty ItemStacks of the given list in slot order, with trailing empty slots trimmed (nil when the inventory/list cannot be resolved).

args.name: list
args.desc: Inventory list to list (default "main").

args.name: pos
args.desc: If given, operate on the node inventory at this position instead of the NPC's own.

args.name: player
args.desc: If given, operate on this player's inventory instead of the NPC's own.

name: npc:inv:put
summary: Puts an item into the inventory: with index it replaces that slot and returns the displaced stack; without index it adds the item and returns the leftover (nil when everything was placed).

args.name: item
args.desc: Item to put: an itemstring (e.g. "default:wood", "default:wood 5") or an ItemStack.

args.name: list
args.desc: Inventory list to put into (default "main").

args.name: index
args.desc: If given, replace this slot; otherwise the item is added.

args.name: pos
args.desc: If given, operate on the node inventory at this position instead of the NPC's own.

args.name: player
args.desc: If given, operate on this player's inventory instead of the NPC's own.

name: npc:inv:remove
summary: Removes items from the inventory, either by item (name/itemstring, optional count, matched anywhere in the list) or from one slot (index, optional count). Returns the ItemStack actually removed, or nil.

args.name: item
args.desc: Item to remove by name (itemstring or ItemStack); used when index is not given.

args.name: index
args.desc: If given, remove from this slot instead of by item.

args.name: count
args.desc: Number of items to remove (default: the whole slot/stack).

args.name: list
args.desc: Inventory list to remove from (default "main").

args.name: pos
args.desc: If given, operate on the node inventory at this position instead of the NPC's own.

args.name: player
args.desc: If given, operate on this player's inventory instead of the NPC's own.

name: npc:inv:room_for
summary: Returns how much of the given item fits into the given list (the room available for it).

args.name: item
args.desc: Item to check room for (itemstring or ItemStack).

args.name: list
args.desc: Inventory list to check (default "main").

args.name: pos
args.desc: If given, operate on the node inventory at this position instead of the NPC's own.

args.name: player
args.desc: If given, operate on this player's inventory instead of the NPC's own.

name: npc:inv:size
summary: Resizes (or creates) the given inventory list to the given size; node inventories have fixed sizes and will fail to resize.

args.name: size
args.desc: New size (slot count) of the list.

args.name: list
args.desc: Inventory list to resize (default "main").

args.name: pos
args.desc: If given, operate on the node inventory at this position instead of the NPC's own.

args.name: player
args.desc: If given, operate on this player's inventory instead of the NPC's own.

name: npc:inv:take_from
summary: Takes items from another inventory (a chest/node via pos, a player via player - the source must be explicit) into the NPC's own inventory. Nothing is dropped: whatever does not fit is returned as leftover. Returns {taken = ItemStack, leftover = ItemStack or nil}, or nil when nothing could be taken.

args.name: pos
args.desc: Position of the node inventory (e.g. a chest) to take from.

args.name: player
args.desc: Name of the player to take from (alternative to pos).

args.name: list
args.desc: Source inventory list to take from (default "main").

args.name: index
args.desc: If given, take from this specific slot of the source.

args.name: count
args.desc: Number of items to take (default: the whole slot/stack).

args.name: item
args.desc: Item to take by name (itemstring or ItemStack); used when index is not given.

args.name: to
args.desc: Destination list in the NPC's own inventory (default "main").

name: npc:inv:wield
summary: Sets (or clears, with no item) the NPC's held item by replacing the "hand" slot and syncing the engine's wielded item; returns true on success.

args.name: item
args.desc: Item to hold (itemstring or ItemStack); omit to clear the hand.

name: npc:timer:instr:start
summary: Compiler-generated control instruction: arms the per-instruction timer (resets it to 0) so that individual instructions are timed/stepped by the interpreter.

name: npc:timer:instr:stop
summary: Compiler-generated control instruction: disables the per-instruction timer.

name: npc:timer:register
summary: Registers a timer with the current process: a named timer with an interval, an initial value, an optional maximum execution count and a function body (compiler-generated from the timer's instruction list).

args.name: name
args.desc: Name of the timer to register.

args.name: interval
args.desc: Timer interval in seconds between executions.

args.name: initial_value
args.desc: Initial value of the timer (default 0).

args.name: times_to_run
args.desc: Maximum number of executions before the timer stops (optional).

args.name: timer_func_index
args.desc: Instruction index of the first instruction of the timer's function body (compiler-generated).

name: npc:timer:start
summary: Starts (enables) the named process timer.

args.name: name
args.desc: Name of the timer to start.

name: npc:timer:stop
summary: Stops (disables) the named process timer.

args.name: name
args.desc: Name of the timer to stop.

name: npc:model:set_animation
summary: Plays the named animation of the NPC's model at a given speed, optionally playing another animation after a non-looping one finishes.

args.name: name
args.desc: Name of the animation registered on the NPC's model.

args.name: speed
args.desc: Animation speed; defaults to the animation's registered speed or 30.

args.name: animation_after
args.desc: Animation to play after this one finishes (applies only when the animation does not loop).

name: npc:distance_to
summary: Returns the distance from the NPC to a given node or object.

args.name: pos
args.desc: table, with x, y and z. If given, will return the distance to the given position. Shouldn't be used together with `object`

args.name: object
args.desc: If given, will return distance from NPC to given object at that time. Shouldn't be used together with `pos`

args.name: round
args.desc: If given, will round distance value using `vector.round()`

name: npc:random
summary: Returns a random number in the given range. Same as Lua's `math.random`.

args.name: start
args.desc: The beginning of the range

args.name: end
args.desc: The end of the range

name: npc:util:str:replace
summary: Returns a copy of the string with occurrences of the target replaced by the replacement value (Lua string.gsub).

args.name: str
args.desc: Source string to perform the replacement on.

args.name: target
args.desc: Pattern/text to look for in str.

args.name: replacement
args.desc: Replacement text for matches of target.

name: npc:util:vector:add
summary: Returns the sum of two vectors (or vector plus a scalar applied to all components).

args.name: x
args.desc: Vector (x/y/z).

args.name: y
args.desc: Vector (component-wise operation) or number (same value added to all components).

name: npc:util:vector:divide
summary: Returns the component-wise division of two vectors (vector.divide).

args.name: x
args.desc: Vector (x/y/z) to divide.

args.name: y
args.desc: Vector (x/y/z) to divide by.

name: npc:util:vector:multiply
summary: Returns the component-wise multiplication of two vectors (vector.multiply).

args.name: x
args.desc: Vector (x/y/z) to multiply.

args.name: y
args.desc: Vector (x/y/z) to multiply by.

name: npc:util:vector:subtract
summary: Returns the component-wise difference of two vectors (vector.subtract).

args.name: x
args.desc: Vector (x/y/z) to subtract from.

args.name: y
args.desc: Vector (x/y/z) to subtract.

name: npc:debug
summary: Logs a debug message to the server log, with an optional value dumped alongside it.

args.name: msg
args.desc: Message to log.

args.name: val
args.desc: Optional value to dump (via dump()) after the message.
